messages: The #b#t2430049##k carries a hint about the next place.\r\n\r\nThis time the trail runs #binto the trees#k.
The #b#t2430049##k reads:\n#e#b"The forest remembers what the traveler forgets."#k#n\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.#k
High up in #b#m10002004##k, an old tree had kept the next sheet all this time.\r\n\r\nThe #b#t2430050##k is mine.
name: [Event] The Third Mark
demandSummary: Search the high branches deep in the ancient woods.
